title: Shared definitions for thread on-disk formats
$comment: Definitions shared by the other schemas.

threadId.description: Random short id with no timestamp in it. Ids are unique per store. The slug is separate and only for humans.

slug.description: Human-readable handle, derived from the title at creation, not unique, never used for resolution.

eventId.description: Sortable timestamp plus four random characters, e.g. 20260918T131501-7kmq.

identity.description: Who did something. The session id is always required; an agent id is optional, for hosts that have one.

session.description: The session id (THREAD_SESSION, set by the harness plugin). Opaque to Spindle. Required.

agent.description: Optional agent id (THREAD_AGENT), for hosts where a named agent runs many sessions.

host.description: Which host adapter produced the identity (pi, claude-code, …). Optional; diagnostic only.

threadState.description: active and inactive are live states. inactive means untouched for a while: the doctor sets it, and any later activity makes the thread active again. merged (a subthread folded into its parent), completed (a top-level thread whose work is done) and dropped (not worth pursuing) are final. Archiving is a location (threads/archived/YYYY-MM/), not a state.

loggedThreadState.description: A state as written in a log: the current names, plus the older `open`, `closed` and `superseded`. The fold reads open as active, closed as completed (merged when the reason is `merged`), and superseded as dropped.

relPath.description: Path relative to the thread folder, forward slashes: under docs/ or artifacts/, or the reading guide.

registration.description: A doc or artifact listed on the thread's view page, or an update to the thread's reading guide. Docs are orientation guides meant to steer future work; artifacts are records. Docs also need read-when; the reading guide needs no purpose.

kind.description: doc (the path is under docs/), artifact (under artifacts/), or reading-guide (reading-guide.md); the tool refuses a kind that doesn't match the path. Older registrations carry one of twelve retired kinds; readers map those by folder, so they stay valid here but are never written now.

anyOf.description: Retired kinds, readable in old logs only.

purpose.description: One line: what this is for (for the reading guide, optional: what changed). Capped so the index stays one line per entry.

read-when.description: Docs only: when a future agent should read this before acting. Required for paths under docs/.

supersedes.description: Path of an earlier registration this one replaces. Reserved; the current tool doesn't write it.
